summary: Defender XDR role assignments are created again, and template imports no longer offer duplicate groups.

fixes.title: Defender XDR role assignments work
fixes.text: Microsoft refused every new Defender XDR role assignment. They are now created, and the next run assigns every group that was waiting for its role.

fixes.title: Templates reuse existing groups
fixes.text: Importing a permission template from Templates now reuses groups you already have instead of offering duplicates, and the card says how many it reuses.
